important_scope_limits: Wix is read-only. Squarespace publication supports commerce products, not general pages or blogs.
GitLab and Bitbucket patches are restricted to HTML/JSON metadata; they do not merge or claim completed framework CI.
Webflow and Contentful save unpublished or staged changes. Sanity edits existing drafts. Framer does not publish.
WordPress and WooCommerce lack atomic provider revision preconditions; a narrow read/write race remains despite preflight checks.
Business-hour changes require matching unexpired trusted facts. Prices, inventory, reviews, crawler directives and publication status are protected.
A provider readback is distinct from deployed-page verification. Neither proves indexing or ranking.
Paid model and SERP experiments require explicit collection. They are not periodic tasks.
API experiments, consumer observations, crawler requests and rankings are distinct evidence types.

platforms.name: Google Search Console
platforms.scope: Search analytics, sitemap status and indexed-URL inspection. Average position is not a fixed rank; top-row coverage is bounded.

platforms.name: WordPress
platforms.scope: Pages and posts; registered REST meta fields only. Configure SEO plugin field mappings explicitly. Published content keeps its status.

platforms.name: WooCommerce
platforms.scope: Product names, descriptions and short descriptions. Prices, inventory and reviews are never changed.

platforms.name: Shopify
platforms.scope: Product SEO title and description via versioned GraphQL. Theme edits and theme publication are not part of this connector.

platforms.name: Webflow
platforms.scope: Static-page SEO metadata and mapped CMS fields. Changes are staged; publishing the whole site is not automatic.

platforms.name: Google Analytics 4
platforms.scope: Landing-page sessions, engagement, key events and revenue. Attribution depends on the property's tracking setup.

platforms.name: Vercel
platforms.scope: Deployment status and signed events. Only the configured production origin and environment can trigger verification.

platforms.name: Netlify
platforms.scope: Deployment status. Use the signed generic deployment event from CI for a consistent verification payload.

platforms.name: Other hosting / CI
platforms.scope: Signed deployment events from any host; replay, origin, freshness and environment checks enforced.

platforms.name: GitLab
platforms.scope: File reads, guarded branch commits and merge requests on GitLab.com. Self-hosted endpoints require a separately reviewed host configuration.

platforms.name: Bitbucket
platforms.scope: File reads, guarded branch commits and pull requests on Bitbucket Cloud. Existing PR lifecycle must be completed in Bitbucket.

platforms.name: Bing Webmaster Tools
platforms.scope: Query statistics and crawl statistics. AI citation dashboard ingestion is not claimed without a documented accessible API.

platforms.name: Google Business Profile
platforms.scope: Read business details and update regular hours from unexpired trusted project facts. Google API approval is required.

platforms.name: Cloudflare
platforms.scope: Sampled request analytics, paths and response statuses. Dataset availability depends on plan; visits do not establish citations or bot identity.

platforms.name: Server logs
platforms.scope: Import bounded structured request records. User agents are self-reported; no user IPs or cookies are stored.

platforms.name: Wix
platforms.scope: Read site SEO tags plus live-page audits. Page-level writes are withheld until the relevant Wix page/app API can be validated; proposals can be exported.

platforms.name: Squarespace
platforms.scope: Commerce product SEO metadata. General pages and blogs use live-page audits and exported recommendations; no general page-edit API is assumed.

platforms.name: Framer
platforms.scope: Official Server API bridge for CMS reads and mapped CMS-field changes. Requires Node and the bundled framer-api bridge; no automatic production deployment.

platforms.name: Sanity
platforms.scope: Mapped document fields with revision preconditions. Only existing draft documents are writable; publish through the customer's normal review flow.

platforms.name: Contentful
platforms.scope: Mapped entry fields with version preconditions. Updates stay unpublished; publication is managed through Contentful.

platforms.name: Keyword & competitor rankings
platforms.scope: Paid Google organic SERP observations by query, location and language. One bounded live task per explicit collection; charges are recorded when returned.

platforms.name: AI answer visibility
platforms.scope: Search-enabled API experiments and separately labelled imports of consumer observations. Never presented as universal rankings or consumer-product coverage.

deployment.runtime_configuration: Existing service identity, encrypted secrets, named database and worker configuration preserved
